quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #11
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 14

questions.question: What should you do if your vehicle's right wheels leave the pavement?

options.text: Pull completely off the road right away and get back on when safe.
Speed up and steer back onto the road quickly.
Take your foot off the gas, slow down, then carefully steer back onto the road when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take your foot off the gas, slow down, then carefully steer back onto the road when safe.
questions.explanation: If your right wheels leave the pavement, stay calm. Remove your foot from the gas and steer parallel to the road. Slow down gradually. Use both hands on the wheel and steer gently back onto the road. Check for traffic before returning to the pavement.

questions.question: Which of the following does NOT happen after drinking alcohol?

options.text: Your judgment of speed and distance gets worse.
You feel calmer and can focus better.

questions.correctAnswerText: You feel calmer and can focus better.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your reaction time, reduces your vision, worsens your judgment of speed and distance, reduces your ability to recover from headlight glare, and makes you more likely to take risks.

questions.question: Which vehicles must stop at all railroad crossings?

options.text: School buses and buses carrying passengers

questions.correctAnswerText: School buses and buses carrying passengers
questions.explanation: School buses, buses with passengers, and vehicles carrying explosives or flammable materials must stop at all railroad crossings.

questions.question: A solid yellow line on your side of the centerline means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Do not pass.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line next to your lane means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Warning.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers of dangers or special conditions ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.correctAnswerText: A railroad crossing.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: When a school bus is stopped to load or unload children, you must:

options.text: Stop completely until all children have left the bus.
Stop completely until the red lights stop flashing and the stop arm is pulled in.
Change lanes, drive slowly, and pass the bus carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely until the red lights stop flashing and the stop arm is pulled in.
questions.explanation: When a school bus stops with flashing red lights and its stop arm out, you must stop completely. Wait until the lights stop flashing and the arm is pulled in before moving. Even after the bus moves, do not go until you are sure no children are crossing.

questions.question: To avoid glare from an oncoming car's headlights:

options.text: Look briefly toward the right side of the road.
Keep your eyes on the road's centerline.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look briefly toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: Look briefly to the right side of the road to avoid the bright lights of an oncoming vehicle. Then continue looking ahead to track the other car's position.

questions.question: After stopping for a school bus that is unloading children:

options.text: Do not go until children wave to you.
Watch for children walking along the side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children walking along the side of the road.
questions.explanation: After stopping for a school bus with flashing lights and its stop arm out, watch for children walking along the side of the road. Always drive carefully when children are near.

questions.question: If you must park in an unusual location:

options.text: Park with your reverse lights on.
Make sure drivers can see your vehicle from all directions.
Park five feet from the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure drivers can see your vehicle from all directions.
questions.explanation: You must make sure your parked vehicle is visible to drivers approaching from any direction so it does not become a hazard.

questions.question: What is an important step when turning?

options.text: Always move to the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check traffic in all directions.
questions.explanation: Before turning, look behind and to both sides of your vehicle to make sure it is safe. Slow down to a safe speed for the turn.

questions.question: Which statement about BAC (blood alcohol content) is true?

options.text: A breathalyzer test measures a person's BAC.
A chemical test is required to convict someone of drunk driving.
Coffee or a cold shower will lower your BAC after drinking.

questions.correctAnswerText: A breathalyzer test measures a person's BAC.
questions.explanation: A breathalyzer is a test that measures BAC. A chemical test is not required for a drunk driving conviction. A police officer can testify about how someone was driving and their appearance and behavior instead.

questions.question: What does a red circle with a slash through it mean on a regulatory sign?

options.text: Some drivers must yield to others.
Drive slower than the speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: An action is forbidden.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with red and black markings. A red circle with a slash means the action shown below it is not allowed.

questions.question: If a large truck is backing up and you need to pass behind it, you should:

options.text: Wait until the truck finishes backing up before you pass.
Honk your horn to alert the driver.
Assume the driver can see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the truck finishes backing up before you pass.
questions.explanation: Large trucks have big blind spots in the back. The driver likely cannot see you. Always wait for the truck to stop backing up before you pass it.

questions.question: Allow extra space when following a:
questions.correctAnswerText: Motorcycle.
questions.explanation: Follow motorcycles from farther back. They stop faster than other vehicles. You need room to stop if the rider brakes or falls. Also, motorcycles are hard to see at night because they have only one tail light.

questions.question: When can you legally drive around or under a railroad crossing gate?

options.text: When you can see clearly in both directions.
When the warning lights are not flashing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never.
questions.explanation: Never go around or under a lowered gate at a railroad crossing. After the gate is raised, only cross the tracks if you can see clearly in both directions and are sure no trains are coming.

questions.question: You are driving in the right lane and want to move to the left lane. You should:

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for traffic behind you.
Look over your left shoulder to check your blind spot.
Check your side mirror and turn on your turn signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors and look over your shoulder to make sure no vehicles are in the lane. Always signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane ends or the road gets narrower ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane ends or the road gets narrower ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.question: If your vehicle loses traction because of water on the road, you should:

options.text: Drive at the same speed to get better traction.
Slow down gradually without using the brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down gradually without using the brakes.
questions.explanation: When driving in heavy rain, tires can lose contact with the road at speeds as low as 30 mph and ride on water instead. This is called hydroplaning. If this happens, slow down gradually and do not use the brakes.

questions.question: What colors are exit distance signs on a highway?
questions.correctAnswerText: Green with white letters
questions.explanation: Signs that show where to go are green with white letters or symbols.
